definitions.explanation: The right or power of a community, organization, or region to govern itself independently.

examples.japanese: {地方|ちほう}{自治|じち}は{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}の{基本|きほん}だ。
examples.english: Local self-government is the basis of democracy.

examples.japanese: {学生|がくせい}{自治|じち}{会|かい}が{イベント|いべんと}を{企画|きかく}した。
examples.english: The student council organized an event.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{自治|じち}{権|けん}を{持|も}っている。

notes:
USAGE: Used in political, organizational, and administrative contexts.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{地方|ちほう}{自治|じち} (local self-government)
・{自治|じち}{体|たい} (municipality, local authority)
・{自治|じち}{会|かい} (self-governing body, student council)
・{自治|じち}{権|けん} (autonomy, right of self-government)
・{住民|じゅうみん}{自治|じち} (resident self-governance)

IN JAPAN: {自治|じち}{体|たい} refers to prefectures, cities, towns, and villages that have local governing powers.
